ctu2.sentence: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students who wish to pursue higher education in the form of M.Phil. and PhD degrees.

ctu1.sentence: The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

ctu2.sentence: The National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students is administered by the University Grants Commission.

ctu1.sentence: The contact details for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment can be found on their official website.

ctu2.sentence: According to reports, the fellowship has significantly improved the enrollment rates of Scheduled Caste students in M.Phil. and PhD programs.
